name: docs-control-plane
description: A documentation and coordination control-plane scaffold: project registry, evidence-first engineering method, agent roles, session workflows, backlog and milestone contracts, and a workspaces/ boundary that never absorbs nested repositories. Generates no runtime code.
recommended_use: Use for cross-project engineering control planes, program coordination repositories, and governance or documentation projects whose primary product is decisions, registries and evidence rather than executable code. Generates no src/, no build manifest, no Dockerfile and no Jenkinsfile.
smoke_test_command: set -e; for f in README.md CLAUDE.md ENGINEERING-METHOD.md PROJECTS.yaml NOW.md MILESTONES.md .gitignore docs/runbook.md planning/backlog.jsonl planning/backlog.schema.json planning/dependencies.yaml planning/decisions/.gitkeep handoffs/current/.gitkeep handoffs/archive/.gitkeep projects/.gitkeep workspaces/.gitkeep; do test -f "$f" || { echo "missing: $f"; exit 1; }; done; for bad in src pyproject.toml package.json pom.xml Dockerfile docker-compose.yml Jenkinsfile; do test ! -e "$bad" || { echo "unexpected: $bad"; exit 1; }; done; python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("planning/backlog.schema.json"))'; grep -q 'workspaces/[*]' .gitignore; grep -q '[!]workspaces/[.]gitkeep' .gitignore; python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; tok=chr(123)*2; bad=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.parts and tok in p.read_text(errors='ignore')]; sys.exit('unresolved tokens: '+repr(bad) if bad else 0)"; echo docs-control-plane smoke ok
